doc.title: Monthly Updates [May]
doc.html:
INFO These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our Commits Page on GitHub or Updates Channel in Discord.

Wiki Updates

  • Made a FMHY Redlib Instance + our SearXNG is working again too.

  • Added an ARPG / MMORPG section in Gaming Tools.

  • Added STEM + Kindle Tools sections in Reading.

  • Added Disc Utilities + Video Enhancement / Effects sections in Video Tools.

  • Split the Steam / Epic section into subsections: Client Tools, DLC Unlock / DRM Bypass, and Steam Store.

  • Split the macOS section into subsections: Video, Audio, Image, Internet, System, and File.

  • Split PDF Tools into subsections: Online Toolkits, Offline Toolkits, Conversion, and Utilities.

  • Split Video Processing into Programs and Online sections.

  • Re-organized & added labels to Android Text Editors, Note-Taking, and To-Do. Before vs. After

  • Re-organized & added labels to Ambient Sound Mixers and Android Browsers. Before vs. After

  • Re-organized & added labels to Website Templates, WordPress Themes, and YouTube Movies. Before vs. After

  • Re-organized the Manga Section based on Poll Results. Congrats to ComicK for coming out on top.

  • Moved Website Generators out of storage, re-organized, and added labels. Before vs. After

  • Moved 3D Modeling + CAD Sections out of storage, re-organized, and added labels. Before vs. After

  • All media tracking sections have now been split into Tracking / Databases and Recommendations. This applies to Streaming, Gaming, Reading, and Audio sections.

Stars Added ⭐

  • Starred AnimeKai in Anime Streaming. Feature-rich, huge library, fast servers. People seem to really like it, so we've moved it to the #1 spot.

  • Starred both 111477 + DramaSuki in Drives / Directories. Both have fast speeds and lots of content.

  • Starred BatCave in Comic Sites. New comic site with tracking, ratings, and a nice UI.

  • Starred PairDrop in P2P File Transfer. Open-source, easy to use, and allows creating rooms.

  • Starred Five Books in Book Recommendations. Expert-recommended top 5 lists with lots of categories.

  • Starred VideoGameCanon in Game Recommendations. Game top 1,000 list that people in our server find useful.

  • Starred Mini QR in URL Tools. Lets you create custom QR code art.

  • Starred Table Habit in Android Productivity Trackers. Open-source, updated regularly, and has a nice UI.

  • Starred both BGBye + Pixelcut in Background Removers as they seemed to work the best.

  • Starred EncycloSearch in Encyclopedias. Combines two dozen encyclopedias into one search engine.

  • Starred Exact Audio Copy in Audio Ripping. Popular CD ripping tool, recommended in Redacted's interview guide.

  • Switched to AI Studio as Google's main chatbot as it works well on mobile, is less laggy, has chat history, and has less censorship than Gemini.

  • Added Free-Official-YouTube-Content as an index emoji in Free w/ Ads. Not a star, but we feel it's good enough to mention.

Things Removed

  • Removed ReVanced MMT as it's no longer maintained.
